// diagnostic

E1019

`{name}` is a `#run fn`, which runs while building, but run-time code calls it here

What

`{name}` is a `#run fn`, which runs while building, but run-time code calls it here

Why

A `#run fn` runs only while the program builds. Called from code in the shipped program, it would run at run time instead, and a panic or print in it would happen there instead of stopping the build.

Fix

Compute the value while building with `value: #run {name}(…)` and use `value` here, or call `{name}` from compile-time code.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E1019: Tests/UI/comptime_no_silent_fallback_run_fn_call.stderr.

Error [jet.ComptimeMethodCalledAtRunTime]: `Small.from_literal` is a `#run fn`, which runs while building, but run-time code calls it here
  --> Tests/UI/comptime_no_silent_fallback_run_fn_call.jet:16:18
    |
 16 |     small: Small.from_literal(500)
    |                  ^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: A `#run fn` runs only while the program builds. Called from code in the shipped program, it would run at run time instead, and a panic or print in it would happen there instead of stopping the build.
 Fix: Compute the value while building with `value: #run Small.from_literal(…)` and use `value` here, or call `Small.from_literal` from compile-time code.
